cards.title: TOO SOON? TOO LATE.
cards.sub: 'Not yet' forever turns into 'never'.

cards.title: GOOD DAYS ONLY? NOTHING GETS DONE.
cards.sub: Show up on the bad ones too.

cards.title: BRAVER THAN YOU BELIEVE, STRONGER THAN YOU THINK.
cards.sub: There's more in you than you know.

cards.title: EVERYBODY GROWS AT DIFFERENT RATES.
cards.sub: Your pace is still progress.

cards.title: SAME 24 HOURS. LIVE THEM.
cards.sub: Nobody gets extra. Spend yours well.

cards.title: IMPORTANT TO YOU? FIND A WAY.
cards.sub: If not, you'll find an excuse.

cards.title: STRENGTH COMES FROM OVERCOMING IT.
cards.sub: Especially what you thought you couldn't.

cards.title: WANT SOMETHING? GO GET IT.
cards.sub: Learn how to chew.

cards.title: 100% HUMAN / 0% ROBOT
cards.sub: All heart. No autopilot.

cards.title: IT'S ONLY METAL.
cards.sub: If it's metal, it's fixable.

cards.title: DO ONLY GOOD EVERYDAY.
cards.sub: That's the rule. Every day.

cards.title: STAY AWESOME, HUMANS!
cards.sub: Pass it on.

cards.title: TIRED BUT STILL HERE.
cards.sub: Still here beats never showed up.

cards.title: POWERED BY SPITE & SNACKS
cards.sub: Breakfast of champions.

cards.title: YOU NEVER FALL UNTIL YOU STOP TRYING.
cards.sub: Down is a place. Staying is a choice.

cards.title: SMALL EFFORTS. EVERY SINGLE DAY.
cards.sub: That's the whole secret. It was never a secret.

cards.title: BRAVEST THING YOU CAN BE? YOURSELF.
cards.sub: No costume. No permission slip needed.

cards.title: CAN'T CONTROL EVENTS. YOU CONTROL THE RESPONSE.
cards.sub: That's where all your power is hiding.

cards.title: PATIENCE. PRACTICE. TIME. CHANGE SHOWS UP.
cards.sub: Slow doesn't mean never.

cards.title: BROKEN ISN'T DONE. IT'S A STARTING POINT.
cards.sub: Ask anyone who fixes things for a living.

cards.title: LAUGH FIRST. FIGURE IT OUT SECOND.
cards.sub: Works on almost every problem humans have.

cards.title: CREATE YOUR OWN REALITY. FEED YOUR MIND GOOD STUFF. DO WHAT EXCITES YOU.
cards.sub: Your head, your rules.

cards.title: DON'T AIM TO LIVE FOREVER. CREATE SOMETHING THAT DOES.
cards.sub: Leave something behind that outlives you.

cards.title: YOU DON'T HAVE TO MOVE MOUNTAINS. JUST FALL IN LOVE WITH LIFE.
cards.sub: Start by loving the life you've got.

cards.title: ORDINARY VS. EXTRAORDINARY? THAT LITTLE EXTRA.
cards.sub: Work for the little extra.

cards.title: BE KIND TO UNKIND PEOPLE. THEY NEED IT THE MOST.
cards.sub: Kindness isn't weakness. It's the whole point.

cards.title: SHOW UP FOR YOUR PEOPLE. THAT'S THE WHOLE JOB.
cards.sub: Everything else is just details.

cards.title: REST IS PART OF THE WORK. EVEN WELDERS PUT THE TORCH DOWN.
cards.sub: You can't run on empty forever.
